title: The Global Spherical Shell conjecture

result.label: The Global Spherical Shell conjecture
result.statement: Every connected minimal compact complex surface of class VII with b2 0 contains a global spherical shell, proving the positive- b 2 Global Spherical Shell conjecture. Such a shell is a holomorphically embedded neighborhood of the standard three-sphere in C^2 0 whose complement is connected.
